name: Emma
source:
Emma is the daughter of "a common vampire family" without castles, bloodlines, or eternal surnames. She lived "on the southern coast of France" with the rest of her house [spoiler]before the Circle's accusation and commencement of their slaughter.[/spoiler] Today, she "moves around a lot" and "lives hidden among hunters."

[b]Childhood:[/b]
Being "born already [in] vampire families" and [spoiler]knowing they would "share the same consort" someday[/spoiler], she and Dakaria knew eachother since they were newborns "almost two hundred years ago." As kids, though she was a bit younger than Dakaria, they fought "every other day" since their families lived in an enclave "in the same district" and Emma allegedly wasn't always "a saint". But even with the fighting, they were "inseparable friends" in a literal sense.

[b]Appearance:[/b]
Only 1-3 inches taller than her counterpart and of a slightly thicker build, Emma has medium length brunette hair with blunt bangs, thick lips, a scar down her left cheek, and cold eyes that bear a strange red halo around the pupil as if hovering over the dark red iris.

[b]Body Type:[/b] Bottom Hourglass shape with large breasts, thick thighs, and a fat ass.
[b]Vampire Type[/b]: [spoiler]non-pureblood daughter of a common vampire family[/spoiler]
[b]Relations:[/b] Dakaria (friend [spoiler]since childhood[/spoiler]), Harkiva ([spoiler]ex-childhood friend[/spoiler])
